low_bandwidth.description: Whether the bridge is in its low-bandwidth mode: datapoints capped, cameras reduced or stopped. Bridge-reported.

health_reason.description: Cloud-observed connection health: `job_query_unanswered` after a bridge ignores held-job queries; `null` on an ordinary connect or disconnect. Optional for older observations.

failsafe.description: The bridge's failsafe watchdog: `failed` while the bridge takes no publishes because it cannot promise a failsafe on time; `null` until the bridge states it. Bridge-reported. Optional for older observations.
